evaluation.ground_truth: Pascal VOC XML annotations mapped from 61 CGHD labels to the existing 16 detector classes
evaluation.common_metric: Visible component inventory count comparison, micro precision/recall/F1, exact inventory match, and mean absolute count error
evaluation.yolo_detection_metric: Existing TensorRT YOLO box evaluation at IoU 0.50
evaluation.comparability_warning: DeepSeek-only and YOLO-plus-DeepSeek were not given or scored on ground-truth bounding boxes. Their inventory metrics are not mAP, IoU, or localization metrics and must not be compared directly with YOLO mAP.

interpretation: YOLO-only is strongest on the common inventory F1 metric: 0.896.
YOLO plus DeepSeek improves over DeepSeek-only by 0.208 inventory F1 points, but is below YOLO-only by 0.068 points.
The hybrid mode reduces missed components substantially versus DeepSeek-only, from 777 false negatives to 354.
Exact full-inventory match is 0.0 for all modes because the subset contains dense diagrams and the comparison uses exact class counts.
The LLM modes were not scored for bounding-box IoU. Their results measure structured component inventory extraction, while YOLO detection metrics measure localized instances.
limitations: This is a 50-image subset, not the full CGHD validation set.
The LLM evaluation asks DeepSeek for canonical component labels and counts, not boxes.
DeepSeek was evaluated with a separate request per image and had 100 percent JSON parse success, but API latency was high.
The hybrid prompt supplied summarized YOLO evidence as untrusted evidence and asked DeepSeek to verify it against the image.
